name: Shadow Warrior and Shadow Master monster panel
description: Hovering a Shadow Warrior or Shadow Master shows the monster health panel like every other summon, so Monster Display shows their life, level and resistances. The game's hover code had a hardcoded exception for monstats.txt rows 417 and 418 that drew only a name label over their head.

patches.description: Hover code: remove the jump that sends monstats.txt row 417 (Shadow Warrior) to the name-label-only branch. The id compare is kept as the byte check; only the jump becomes NOPs.
Hover code: the same for monstats.txt row 418 (Shadow Master).
